sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "debate_people"."Negative" AS e, "people"."Party" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "debate_people" JOIN "people" ON "people"."People_ID" = "debate_people"."Negative"  GROUP BY "debate_people"."Negative", "people"."Party"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v") SELECT AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5"
construction: agg:people within people.Party > share:g > baseline:all > agg:all
why: share of the g total of number of debate_people records (g level)
gap to the all average of number of debate_people records (all level)
